answer: At dawn each agent renews a hardware-attested identity token: a TPM signs a fresh nonce, checked against a registry allowing one token per chip, so a thousand fake accounts need a thousand real chips. New identities enter only through a narrow inlet - vetted sponsors who stake reputation on each newcomer and lose it if the newcomer misbehaves. Sybils also face a copper floor: every identity locks a modest refundable deposit, slashed on proven abuse, so ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand deposits plus ten thousand chips, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the one-time lock.
